svg.text: SIDE VIEW (looking at the left side of the boom; quad is to the left, glider hangs on the right)
latch length 35.0 mm (socket 22, rail+posts to the tip)
TOP VIEW (looking down; the servo pad is drawn dashed because it is ABOVE everything else)
Parts (numbers in the drawings)
boom rod (your rod, dashed)
A: socket tube, clamps on the rod, slit on top
zip-tie groove round socket and rail
pin rail: long guide hole, rear support
eyelet post 1 (near the quad)
gap with the string loop on the pin
eyelet post 2 (far end of the pin)
bridge over the gap (loop falls out downward)
release pin (orange)
servo arm, hook through the arm hole (green)
servo, your size (blue dashes)
A2: servo pad with zip-tie slots
post for the pad (M2 screws or glue)
string loop and glider
Key dimensions (mm)
rod socket bore 4.30 (rod 4.00 ASSUMED)
socket outer 9.10
pin hole 1.20 (pin 1.00 ASSUMED)
pin axis 6.75 below, 1.00 beside the rod axis
post 4.0, gap 5.0, engage 3.0
pin travel needed 9.5, arm throw 14.1
servo shaft 10.1 behind socket rear, 11.0 to the side
pad underside 20.8 above rod axis
pin wire cut length about 41
Design output only. Nothing here has been printed, fitted or flown. Servo, rod, pin and frame sizes are ASSUMED: measure yours and re-run.
